purpose: Source qualification and measurement pilot distinguishing annual headlines from changes in the remaining-period operating outlook; no investment-performance claim.

frozen_sample.selection: Purposive issuer choice for different disclosure formats, frozen by parent before extraction; not selected by market outcomes and not population-representative.
frozen_sample.event_rule: All four quarterly earnings releases PUBLISHED in calendar 2022 per issuer; fiscal periods can end in 2021 or 2022.

classification_contract.primary_information_stage: original earnings release text; exact first public availability not assumed
classification_contract.later_call_handling: Official call context, when inspected, is separate and cannot overwrite a release-time unavailable label.
classification_contract.comparison_unit: Same issuer, metric, target period, accounting/currency basis, and business scope. Different target years and changed exclusions are not like-for-like revisions.
classification_contract.remaining_period_test: Annual maintenance or a changed annual midpoint alone cannot identify a remaining-period revision. No missing values are imputed as unchanged.
classification_contract.numeric_reconstruction: No annual-EPS-minus-quarterly-EPS forecast bridge was constructed.
classification_contract.no_observed_fundamental_repair_inference: A financial/tax benefit, FX translation update, new fiscal year, or scope change is recorded separately from a forward operating revision.

blinding_and_review.achieved_design: Market-outcome-unjoined provisional classification; strict blinding not achieved.
blinding_and_review.incidental_exposure: Initial searches using site: text returned off-scope third-party market-response/consensus/current-price snippets. Explicit domain filtering was then used; one later issuer-report snippet contained TSR. Those sources were not opened for analysis or copied into packets and did not determine labels.
blinding_and_review.review: One native extraction lane per issuer plus integration checks against primary release passages; not independent double annotation. No inter-rater agreement estimate.

coverage_and_qualification.interpretation: Unresolved release-body classifications are retained observations about this source scope, not evidence that the issuer never supplied useful forward information.

common_temporal_limits: A historical page retrieved today and its printed publication date do not alone prove the original text version or exact first public dissemination.
SEC exhibit accession identifies a filed/furnished version; acceptance time, where known, is separate from earliest issuer release time.
Scheduled publication/call times are not observed actual dissemination times.
Call-transcript statements cannot enter earlier release-time information; exact statement and transcript-publication timestamps remain unqualified.
